works.title: Semantic Extraction and Simplification Framework
works.description: A unified framework synthesizing semantic extraction, syntactic simplification, and prompt disambiguation for data formulation. Integrates controlled vocabularies, explicit glossary definitions, and local ontologies to provide referential grounding and eliminate polysemy in unstructured narrative text, with specific application to conversational prompts and LLM working memory optimization.
works.quote: Develop a standardized, information-rich data formulation methodology
